newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Sichuan migrant workers send home billions.
newsitem.headline: China's Sichuan migrant workers send home billions.

text.p: Migrant labourers from the southwestern Chinese province of Sichuan sent home 20.2 billion yuan ($2.43 billion) last year -- equivalent to the province's total financial revenue for 1996, the Financial News said on Monday.
Cash brought home by returning workers was another 10 billion yuan, the newspaper said.
Many poor rural residents from China's inland province have moved as migrant, or floating, labourers to booming cities and coastal regions in search of better-paying jobs in recent years.
The number of surplus rural labourers in Sichuan was now about 20 million, the newspaper said.

It estimated the number of floating labourers from Sichuan at 10 million, including 6.3 million who had left the province to seek jobs elsewhere in China, three million who had remained in Sichuan and 10,000 who had gone abroad, it said.
